method: Origin-constrained least squares of three independently fitted geometric R values versus 1/N
weights: Equal weight per derived resistance; not weighted by LSV sample count
origin_constraint: User-requested zero intercept; (0,0) is not an additional observation
limits: Proportionality is imposed by this fit; only three derived values, not independent validation of a shared kinetic response. Extension to the origin visualizes the constraint, not measured infinite-layer behavior
shared_layer_fit: Separate 61-data joint BV+jR fit, not calibrated from this regression
